column1: # mt4 stage A: the functions of the lift that contain a LOCK-prefixed or implicitly locked instruction (an atomic read-modify-write: fle_cas / fle_xchg / fle_xadd / fle_cmpxchg16b in the generated C). fe-wasmgen does not lower them, so a hybrid list must not name them (reason: contains a LOCK-prefixed or implicitly locked instruction, stays on the C path). Generated by lift/harness/hyb/list-atomic-functions.py from the lift of the F2xH7 input (FLEngine_x64.dll build 5653 and its modules, no Elastique / oggio).
